_comment: Title templates tuned on actual channel data. Winners kept the proven skeleton (TRACKNAME 🔥 hook #N | #afrohouse) with benefit/FOMO/use-case hooks: 'You NEED This' pulled 1,822, 'Late Night Tribal Drive' 660, 'Hits DIFFERENT' 378, 'Fall In Love' 309, 'Workouts & Festival' 274, 'Everyone's Playing' 239. WORLD CUP anthem titles flopped (94) and were dropped. Placeholders: TRACKNAME, {genre}, {mix_number}, {genre_hashtag}. One template per upload, not repeating within the last TITLE_HISTORY_WINDOW picks.
templates: TRACKNAME 🔥 If You Love {genre}, You NEED This #{mix_number} | {genre_hashtag}
